en: A black and white photograph depicting a street scene with mid-rise and low-rise buildings. A notable feature is a newsstand on the right with the word 'Hírlapok' visible. The street is cobblestoned or paved, with people walking and horse-drawn carts present, indicating a historical European setting. There are hills in the background and the architecture suggests Central/Eastern Europe.
